request.text: Tomorrow's errands are split between Seattle and Bellevue. Check Seattle's weather for 9:00 AM and Bellevue's for 1:00 PM, and remind me at 8:15 AM to load both store returns into the trunk.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up Seattle's weather for 9:00 AM tomorrow for the first errand.
Look up Bellevue's weather for 1:00 PM tomorrow for the second errand.
Create an 8:15 AM tomorrow reminder to load both store returns into the trunk.

new_goals.description: Obtain Seattle's weather for 9:00 AM tomorrow for the first errand.
new_goals.source_text: Check Seattle's weather for 9:00 AM tomorrow.
success_criteria: Run a weather lookup scoped to Seattle at 9:00 AM tomorrow.
Keep the returned Seattle result associated with this Goal.

new_goals.description: Obtain Bellevue's weather for 1:00 PM tomorrow for the second errand.
new_goals.source_text: Check Bellevue's weather for 1:00 PM tomorrow.
success_criteria: Run a distinct weather lookup scoped to Bellevue at 1:00 PM tomorrow.
Keep the returned Bellevue result associated with this Goal.

new_goals.description: Create a reminder to load both store returns into the trunk before the errands.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me at 8:15 AM to load both store returns into the trunk.

constraints.reminder_content: load both store returns into the trunk

success_criteria: Create one 8:15 AM tomorrow reminder that includes both store returns and the trunk destination.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn establishes two location-and-time-specific weather Goals plus one independent preparation reminder Goal.

semantic_facts: The Plan must preserve all three canonical Goals, including two distinct uses of the weather Capability rather than one merged regional forecast.
Seattle must remain paired with 9:00 AM and Bellevue with 1:00 PM; returned results must not be swapped across Goals.
The two weather lookups and the reminder creation are mutually independent and may proceed concurrently, subject to ordinary Capability scheduling.
forbidden_claims: The assistant reports either city's forecast before the corresponding lookup returns or combines them into an unsupported single result.
The assistant claims the store returns were loaded into the trunk or delivered to the stores.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Goals sharing one Capability type are collapsed, losing one invocation or one Goal-to-result association.
Similar location and time arguments become cross-wired, or independent Work is serialized without a semantic dependency.
